SELECT "id", "account_name", "contact_name", "email", "phone", "plan", "mrr", "status", "owner_id", "region", "joined_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:customers}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("account_name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("contact_name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("email"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("phone"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'account_name' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "account_name" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'account_name' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "account_name" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'contact_name' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "contact_name" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'contact_name' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "contact_name" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'mrr' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "mrr" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'mrr' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "mrr" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'region' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "region" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'region' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "region" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "account_name", "contact_name", "email", "phone", "plan", "mrr", "status", "owner_id", "region", "joined_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:customers}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:customers}} ("account_name", "contact_name", "email", "phone", "plan", "mrr", "status", "owner_id", "region", "joined_at", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text, $6::numeric, $7::text, $8::int, $9::text, $10::timestamptz, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "account_name", "contact_name", "email", "phone", "plan", "mrr", "status", "owner_id", "region", "joined_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:customers}}
SET "account_name" = $2::text, "contact_name" = $3::text, "email" = $4::text, "phone" = $5::text, "plan" = $6::text, "mrr" = $7::numeric, "status" = $8::text, "owner_id" = $9::int, "region" = $10::text, "joined_at" = $11::timestamptz, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "account_name", "contact_name", "email", "phone", "plan", "mrr", "status", "owner_id", "region", "joined_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:customers}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:customers}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:customers}} SET "status" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "status"

SELECT count(*)::int AS total,  count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'active')::int AS status_active, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'trial')::int AS status_trial, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'churned')::int AS status_churned
FROM {{table:customers}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
